text: answer[math-2f2a674d-open]: The shortest path is 0–3–6, with edge weights 9 and 14. Their total is 9 + 14 = 23, which is shorter than alternatives such as 0–2–3–6 (8 + 4 + 14 = 26). All edge weights are nonnegative, so no route involving additional edges can improve this total. Therefore, the length of the shortest path from node 0 to node 6 is 23.
